attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate OR state corporate excise tax. Applies OR 6.6% flat rate (7.6% for financial institutions) to apportioned and adjusted taxable income, then ensures minimum tax is met.

condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq } over not if

condition_details.condition_comment: Is financial institution; Is financial institution subject to 7.6% rate

action_details.action_comment: Calculate OR tax for financial institutions (7.6% rate); Financial institutions use 7.6% rate instead of 6.6%
action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_tax = apportionment.state_taxable_income * or_result.financial_institution_rate; set apportionment.state_tax = the maximum of (apportionment.state_tax) and (or_result.minimum_tax); set apportionment.state_tax = the maximum of (apportionment.state_tax - apportionment.state_credits) and (or_result.minimum_tax); set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments - apportionment.state_tax;
action_details.action_postfix: apportionment.state_taxable_income or_result.financial_institution_rate fmul cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_tax or_result.minimum_tax fmax cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_tax apportionment.state_credits f- or_result.minimum_tax fmax cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments apportionment.state_tax f- cvd /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef

action_details.action_comment: Calculate OR tax for regular corporations (6.6% rate); Regular corporations use 6.6% flat rate
action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_tax = apportionment.state_taxable_income * apportionment.state_tax_rate; set apportionment.state_tax = the maximum of (apportionment.state_tax) and (or_result.minimum_tax); set apportionment.state_tax = the maximum of (apportionment.state_tax - apportionment.state_credits) and (or_result.minimum_tax); set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments - apportionment.state_tax;
action_details.action_postfix: apportionment.state_taxable_income apportionment.state_tax_rate fmul cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_tax or_result.minimum_tax fmax cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_tax apportionment.state_credits f- or_result.minimum_tax fmax cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments apportionment.state_tax f- cvd /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef

action_details.action_comment: No nexus - no tax liability; No nexus - no tax liability
action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_tax = 0.0; set or_result.minimum_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef 0.0 cvd /or_result.minimum_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments cvd /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef

action_details.action_comment: Nexus but no taxable income (still owe minimum tax!); No excise tax, but MINIMUM TAX STILL APPLIES
action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_tax = or_result.minimum_tax; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments - apportionment.state_tax;
action_details.action_postfix: or_result.minimum_tax cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments apportionment.state_tax f- cvd /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef
